items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And I remember the occasion, it came about that he was gonna go on the road. And I'd come by Mama's house and he was telling us about it, that he had an offer to go with Snookum Russell. Now, Snookum Russell had quite a name, so we knew that was quite a thing.

ctx.x: It's very strange. I remember a couple of things happened to me. One, the last one, really took the biggest effect. One thing happened, I remember Wes went on the road. It was the first time he'd gone out on the road. And I was sort of like...it struck me a little funny when, even though we'd gone our separate ways, we weren't living under the same roof as brothers...youngsters coming up, we'd turned into our adulthood. And I had my family and he had his family,

And I remember the occasion, it came about that he was gonna go on the road. And I'd come by Mama's house and he was telling us about it, that he had an offer to go with Snookum Russell. Now, Snookum Russell had quite a name, so we knew that was quite a thing.
He was in that band the same time Ray Brown was...
